environment.dependencies: Same preinstalled locked node_modules, no install during either build
environment.cache: Fresh per-invocation Astro and Vite cache and output for both paths; warm dependencies/browser; uncontrolled OS page cache

corpus: Original six saved authentic production articles, one offline Render setup shared by both builds; frozen source-reviewed editorial expectations
intentional_ui_differences: Pagefind maintained UI supplies native five-result continuation and section subresults; old UI uses ten-result batches
Visible input label, live status and local-asset failure fallback supplied by small adapter; titles/excerpts otherwise use maintained UI
No JavaScript displays browse fallback without an unusable input
Heading slugs that duplicate explicit archive anchors receive a suffix; original fragments remain unchanged
independence: Complete: independent spec_review checked all six saved sources/frozen expectations, minimized fixtures, both artifacts and both real indexes. See v2-native-site-review.md.
timing_boundaries: Totals comparable end-to-end. Baseline stage numbers are in-process API elapsed times from timing-only worker instrumentation; replacement stage numbers include separate subprocess/CLI startup. Do not compare these boundaries as equivalent API timings.
source_comparison_limits: Equality covers established canonical presentation; existing Render maps raw self-links to archive-heading-N targets. It does not claim raw-source fragment-ID byte identity.
